i18n.zhSummary: 除了回答科学家的问题外，人工智能还开始提出哪些假设需要检验，哪些假设需要优先考虑。在假设比比皆是的时代，人工智能科学的下一个测试平台不是“创意生成” ，而是其判断的可靠性。帖子科学中的下一个问题，现在AI精选首次出现在MIT Technology Review | MIT Technology Review Korea。
i18n.enTitle: The Next Question in Science, Now Picked by AI
i18n.enSummary: Beyond answering scientists' questions, AI began to propose which hypotheses to test and which to prioritize. In an age where hypotheses abound, the next test bed for AI for Science is not ‘idea generation,' but how reliable its judgments are. The post Next question in science, now AI picks appeared first on mit Technology Review | mit Technology Review Korea.
